scope: Polymarket first-party APIs, official documentation, official SDK/repository search

current_orderbook.time_semantics: current snapshot only in documented request schema

realtime_l2.time_semantics: prospective stream from subscription; initial book snapshot plus subsequent updates

historical_l2.reason: Polymarket CLOB matching/order state is off-chain while matched trades settle on-chain; settlement logs do not contain the full state of unfilled/resting/cancelled off-chain orders required to reconstruct historical depth.

audit_policy: Historical bid/ask spread, depth, OFI from full L2, depth-normalized impact, queue state and book-shape features must be marked DATA_UNAVAILABLE_RETRO_FIRST_PARTY for the frozen 2025-2026 sample. They may not be approximated from current books or from last trades and may not be encoded as zero.
prospective_policy: Current /book and market WebSocket may support future/prospective collection only; they are not admissible as retroactive inputs for the frozen sample.
boundary: This is a data-availability decision for the later implementation audit, not a rejection of L2-based techniques in general. A technique can remain conceptually valid but receive NO_GO_FOR_CURRENT_DATA if it requires historical L2.
